imposter.message: a regular evil role with no special abilities.

silencer.message: select a person at any time to be silenced for the next meeting.

poisoner.message: you may poison people instead of killing them normally.

crewmate.message: a regular good role, nothing special.

jester.message: you win if you get voted out.

executioner.message: you win if your target gets voted out.

tasks.name: swipe card
tasks.desc: swipe the card {{{ let times = chance(.9) ? randint(1,6) : randint(20, 30); let text = times === 1 ? 'time 😎' : (times < 20 ? 'times' : 'times 😭'); return times+' '+text}}}

tasks.name: connect wires
tasks.desc:
make these connections without crossing any lines:
{{{ let result = []; let numConnections = randint(6, 8); for(let i = 0; i < numConnections; i++) { let let1 = toLetter(randint(1,6)); let let2 = toLetter(randint(1,6)); if(let1 === let2){ i--; continue; } let connection = let1+let2;let inverseConnection = let2+let1; if(result.includes(connection) || result.includes(inverseConnection)){ i--; continue; } result.push(connection); } return result.join(' ');}}}
